name: wands
description: W.A.N.D.S. (Wands & Wizards) — data, Foundry VTT module, and documentation site

scripts.dev:site: cd site && npx quartz build && npx wrangler pages dev public
scripts.deploy:site: cd site && npx quartz build && npx wrangler pages deploy public --project-name wands-quartz
scripts.install:all: cd data && npm install && cd ../site && npm install
